name: 60173 · Schaumburg, IL
findings: ZIP 60173 (Schaumburg) has 222 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60173 (Schaumburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60173 (Schaumburg) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
